name: claude-manager
description: Gerenciador local de sessões do Claude Code

scripts.dist:linux: npm run predist && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:win: npm run predist && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: npm run predist && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.release:linux: npm run predist && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= electron-builder --publish always --linux AppImage deb
scripts.release:win: npm run predist && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= electron-builder --publish always --win nsis
scripts.release:mac: npm run predist && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= electron-builder --publish always --mac dmg
